constraints.text: Do not add spoken or sung lines.

claims.text: A car pulls forward out of the dark.
Asset-1 governs camera movement and cutting rhythm only; its framing is followed while its actors, objects, setting, lighting and palette are not copied.
The surrounding night air is almost silent apart from the car, with faint room tone and a hint of cold concrete and damp asphalt in the unlit ground.
A restrained low synthesizer drone with a slow pulsing bass note sits under the scene, swelling slightly as the vehicle emerges.
The car's bodywork is a dark, matte finish that swallows light, so only its lamp glow and a thin edge of reflection describe its shape.

summary.text: A car edges forward out of near-total darkness, its silhouette slowly resolving into a lit, closer form across two static shots, accompanied by a low engine rumble, tire roll and a restrained drone score.

description.text: A wide, static frame given almost entirely to darkness. Faint room tone sits under the image, and the unlit ground reads as cold concrete and damp asphalt, its texture only a suggestion of grain in the black. Low in the frame, a car's dim headlights and the front of its body begin to separate from the surrounding night: two weak pools of light, a narrow band of reflected glow along a dark matte hood, and a silhouette that at first could be mistaken for a still shape. The car starts to pull forward at a steady, deliberate pace, and the black around it yields just enough for the front of the vehicle to read as moving rather than parked. Edges stay soft and underlit; nothing else in the space is legible, and the framing itself never shifts.
A low engine rumble and the slow roll of tires on pavement seep in from the darkness.
Two dim headlights and a dark matte front silhouette are barely distinguishable inside the near-total black, with a faint sheen of damp ground beneath.
The car begins to pull forward at a steady, deliberate pace, its silhouette slowly separating from the darkness.

A medium wide static frame on the same unlit space, the surrounding area still largely black. The car continues its forward pull without pause, its nose and headlights now breaking clear of the darkness into the faint available light, drawing nearer to the camera position as it does. The lit front becomes readable: the pale spill of the lamps across the ground, a thin highlight running along the hood and wing, and the dark mass of the body behind it. The engine rumble grows slightly closer and the tires keep rolling forward, and the drone beneath them lifts by a degree. Around the emerging vehicle the darkness never fully lifts, so the sense of a shape crossing from silhouette into visible form, rather than arriving in a lit room, is what completes the move.
The steady engine rumble grows slightly closer and the tires keep rolling forward on the pavement.
The car's nose and headlights break into the faint available light, the body still dark behind the lamps, the space around it mostly unlit.
The vehicle draws nearer the camera position, its lit front growing larger and its shape fully separated from the black by the end of the move.

soundscape: Near-silent night air carrying a low engine rumble and the slow roll of tires on pavement, with only a thin bed of room tone around them.
music: A restrained low synthesizer drone with a slow pulsing bass note that swells slightly as the car emerges into the light.
